answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 72 identities per epoch. Audits are written down in nectar, queued in oasis, and delta publishes the wait time. A farm of 122 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2351 identities would post 1231 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
